# Draft PRiSM data request — not submitted

Subject: Availability of anonymized measured rice-yield records for Albay/Bicol

Dear PhilRice / PRiSM team,

I am developing TerraProof, a research prototype for comparing rice planting calendars in Albay, Philippines. I would like to inquire whether anonymized measured field-season rice-yield records can be shared for research, initially for Albay or the Bicol Region, with available years and seasons specified by your team.

The desired fields are:

- Stable anonymous field ID and permitted coordinates, field boundaries or spatial linkage sufficient to match satellite observations.
- Planting/sowing and transplanting dates where recorded, harvest date, season and year.
- Measured palay yield in t/ha, harvested area, measurement method (e.g. crop cutting), grain moisture basis and quality controls.
- Crop variety and irrigated/rainfed classification where available.
- Data dictionary, provenance, uncertainty and missing-value codes.
- Permitted research uses, spatial privacy restrictions, publication/redistribution terms, and applicable consent or institutional authorization.

Please distinguish measured ground observations from remotely sensed or modeled yield estimates. If raw field records cannot be released, please advise whether an approved research collaboration or data-sharing agreement is possible, and which aggregate products can be supplied instead.

Please confirm available geographic and temporal coverage before preparing an extract. We can narrow the request to one region or one year if needed. The project has not trained a field-yield model or claimed validated accuracy from PRiSM data.

Requester name, affiliation, contact details, intended commercial/noncommercial use and any required endorsement: [to be completed by requester]
